tool_input.body:
## Summary

Withdraws `xboing-qspw`, which I filed in error during #226. Ledger-only change.

Two mistakes, both recorded in the bead's close reason:

- **Misfiled.** It alleged an ethos defect, so it belonged in the ethos project. The convention was already visible in this repo — `xboing-c-xzt` notes "MOVED UPSTREAM as ethos-bfml", and e2ae878 (#221) exists to undo a previous round of exactly this.
- **Wrong.** The finding doesn't reproduce outside xboing, so it isn't a generator defect. Ethos's fixtures author identity descriptions as clauses that slot into the template correctly; xboing wrote sentences, which is what produced the comma splice. And all 18 fixture agent files have one `You report to` line — xboing's have two only because a block guarded by `len(antiResps) > 0` fires when the report target's role defines responsibilities. Xboing's team does; the fixtures don't.

I over-generalized from a single artifact instead of checking whether the Copilot findings reproduced anywhere else.

The upstream copy `ethos-i3a2` was filed and closed the same day with the same disproof. Nothing further filed.

## Test plan

- [x] Ledger-only — no source, build, or packaging files touched
- [x] `bd` state consistent: `xboing-qspw` closed, `ethos-i3a2` closed upstream
